info.title: Dolores desktop shell contracts
info.description: No HTTP API. Selected Flutter shell uses the in-process C ABI in x-flutter-ffi. x-tauri-commands describes alternative Tauri IPC; Iced uses internal Rust events.

free.ownership: Free each live dolores_call result exactly once; null allowed.

arguments.apiKey: string|null; optional; null/omitted reuses active/saved key only for same endpoint, or empty if none
arguments.rememberConnection: boolean; optional; default false; true stores key in OS credential store
arguments.enabledModels: string[]; optional; 1..32 valid IDs including active model; defaults to [preferences.model]

recoverConnection.result: null; reload saved connection; failure clears provider and sets connectionWarning

listModels.result: string[]; sorted unique valid IDs from GET <baseUrl>/models; 20-second timeout, 1 MiB response and 512-entry caps; no configuration changes

selectModel.result: null; persist active model/metadata atomically, preserve key and history

forgetConnection.result: null; deletes saved key/reference and active connection, preserves history/preferences

arguments.workspace: absolute folder string|null; legacy optional; new session creates project, existing session must match immutable saved root

start.result: null; tools follow saved workspace, no session creates temporary working chat; side chats remain streaming; unavailable folders fail

cancel.result: null; stale IDs are a no-op

shutdown.result: null; cancels active run, preserves process-wide engine

arguments.newer: boolean; optional/default false; true requires cursor
boolean; optional/default false; true requires cursor

messagesPage.result: {items:{id:i64,role:user|assistant,content:string,metadata?:TurnMetadata}[0..80],hasOlder:boolean,hasNewer:boolean}; chronological id order; no cursor loads latest; older/newer excludes cursor

arguments.path: absolute string path with .md or .json extension matching format; destination must not exist

export.result: {messageCount:u64}; complete read snapshot streamed to sibling temporary file, synced and published without replacement; no partial destination on write failure; existing files rejected

arguments.session: string|null; optional; null previews a new conversation without creating it
arguments.input: string; empty allowed; at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes
arguments.tools: boolean; optional/default false; appends local tool guidance and applies the same initial context trimming as start

context.result: ContextSummary plus messages; existing session derives tools from stored workspace, tools flag only for unbound draft; no mutation/network

setRequestSettings.result: null; validates and persists nonsecret settings, activates the replacement provider after save; no network or credential changes; rejected during generation

approveTool.result: null; consumes matching approval once; stale/repeated/mismatched/stopped decisions rejected

arguments.path: absolute folder string; required for project, rejected for temporary/side

createSession.result: {session:Session,workspace:SessionWorkspace}; atomic local creation, no provider request

workspace.result: SessionWorkspace; legacy side, missing session rejected

changesPage.result: {items:FileChange[0..20],hasOlder:boolean,hasNewer:boolean}; descending ID, exclusive older cursor; no snapshots/root

changeDetails.result: {change:FileChange,diff:string}; local forward diff, no raw snapshots/root

previewRevert.result: {token:string,target:string,diff:string,operation:restore|remove}; original pending/applied replacement or creation only, saved folder/current after snapshot must match; no write

applyRevert.result: {applied:true,bytesBefore,bytesAfter,changeId:i64,journalStatus:applied|pending,removed?:true}; one-use bound preview, 5-minute expiry; failure consumes token; removed true only for reversal of a creation

cancelRevert.result: null; matching plan discarded, no file mutation

events: {type:modelText,id,number:integer[1..4],text}; working chats only, ordered by model call; no partial arguments or duplicate final delta
x-flutter-ffi.busy: Only poll, cancel, approveTool and shutdown are accepted until the terminal event is drained.

exportSchema.messages: {id:i64,role:user|assistant,content:string,metadata?:TurnMetadata}[]; entire chronological conversation, no credentials/preferences; Markdown preserves title and bodies in variable-length text fences; optional metadata is included in JSON and as an inert text-fenced record in Markdown

accounting.metadata: Completed assistant metadata {model,usage:TokenUsage|null,context:ContextSummary,requestSettings?:RequestSettings}; actual provider snapshot, omitted for old messages/unsupported providers. Text and metadata commit together; delete cascades both. Optional agent:AgentSummary on successful tool runs; top-level usage is null, per-call usage remains separate. File contents are persisted/exported; folder root is excluded. Schema 6 adds local workspaces; message metadata shape is unchanged. Listing/search records can include query and completed status; their names/snippets are saved/exported with a completed turn. Legacy query omission remains valid. Brick 3.4 adds optional agent.steps with public intermediate commentary; final text remains message content. Old summaries without steps remain valid; schema 6 is unchanged.
accounting.context: UTF-8 content bytes including system and current user message; excludes JSON/role overhead. Max 131072 bytes and 40 saved complete turns; not a model token-window guarantee. savedTurns/omittedTurns may be null for plugins without total-count support.
accounting.usage: Provider-reported counters only; missing, null, negative, fractional, string and values over 9007199254740991 remain unavailable. Zero is preserved. Cached/reasoning counts are breakdowns, not additions. No estimated totals, prices, tokenizer or cumulative session totals.

requestControls.timeout: One whole-provider-response deadline including headers, streamed body, queue waits and bounded usage fallback; excludes history reads/final persistence. Fixed 10-second connect and 20-second discovery timeouts remain.
requestControls.recovery: Manual actions only; never automatic failure retry. Retry sends the current edited draft. Guidance uses fixed local strings and does not expose raw provider bodies.

folderTools.default: enabled automatically for project and temporary chats, disabled for explicit side and legacy chats; working folder persists per session
folderTools.approval: Each valid operation requires a run-bound single-use decision. Allow once/Deny gates listing, scanning and reading; Apply once/Deny gates the reviewed local edit diff. Denials match name,target,query,diff within a run. Local edit snapshot preparation does not write or share the snapshot with the provider. Stop/timeout/shutdown clear pending approvals. Create once/Deny gates the complete new-file addition; an occupied path is never replaced.
folderTools.timeout: min(configured timeoutSeconds,300) for the whole model/tool/approval phase, excluding initial preparation and final persistence; OS filesystem calls cannot be forcibly interrupted
folderTools.paths: Relative forward slashes; regular UTF-8 files only; rejects traversal/absolute/control/device/credential/VCS names, binary/NUL/oversized content and outside symlink/junction targets; capability-relative resolution/open after approval. The name filter does not identify every possible secret.
folderTools.persistence: Successful final answer and agent metadata commit with the user message; no partial pairs on Stop/failure/exhaustion. Approved contents are shared with the provider and retained in unencrypted metadata/export. Failed-run cards remain transient. Public intermediate commentary is retained separately as optional agent.steps, shared with the provider alongside its calls and included in complete exports only on success. Optional tool.diff persists/exports the local reviewed edit on success; it is not a filesystem transaction or rollback record.

listing.arguments: {path:string}; required; additional fields rejected; . for root or direct relative folder
listing.result: JSON string {entries:[{path,kind:file|folder}],inspectedEntries,skippedEntries,truncated}; root-relative paths, sorted bounded inspected subset, not necessarily globally first names

search.arguments: {path:string,query:string}; required; additional fields rejected; . for root or direct relative folder; nonblank single-line literal case-sensitive query, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, no controls/regex
search.result: JSON string {matches:[{path,line,text}],inspectedEntries,attemptedFiles,scannedFiles,skippedFiles,skippedEntries,bytesRead,truncated}; root-relative paths, one-based lines, partial coverage when limits reached; skipped/excluded files may contain omitted matches

folderTools.discoveryExclusions: Skip symlink/junction entries and reject alias scopes; common credential/VCS path filter plus node_modules,target,build,dist,.dart_tool,.venv,venv,__pycache__; regular UTF-8 text without NUL only; no background index. Filename filtering cannot detect every secret. Internal .dolores-edit-* staged names are excluded from all folder tools.
folderTools.streaming: Working chats stream public modelText by call number; 128-KiB public text budget across all calls. Indexed function arguments assemble within fixed limits and require a matching complete finish before local approval. One explicit pre-stream unsupported-usage retry only; no tool-free/nonstreaming fallback. Legacy provider plugins can delegate streaming to their completed tool_turn.

editing.arguments: {path:string,old_text:string,new_text:string}; all required, no extra fields. One exact nonempty unique match, including overlapping-match refusal, replaced in an existing writable UTF-8 file. Direct relative paths only; no aliases/credential/VCS paths, NUL/binary, creation/deletion or shell.
editing.preview: Local unified diff with real line numbers, three context lines and missing-newline markers; bound to one call ID and exact preview. At most four prepared plans per run. Optional ToolRequest.diff and ToolRecord.diff each at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes.
editing.publication: Recheck bytes and ordinary permissions, exclusive-create staged file beside target, preserve ordinary permissions, flush, recheck and observe Stop before atomic replacement. Cleanup only owned staged file on failure. Optimistic checks, not a cross-program compare-and-swap guarantee; no universal ACL/xattr preservation claim.
editing.result: status edited; content JSON {applied:true,bytesBefore,bytesAfter,changeId:i64,journalStatus:applied|pending}. Journaled selected host includes changeId and journalStatus; alternative unjournaled registrations omit these fields. Conflict has fixed no-edit-applied message.
editing.effects: Applied files and independent folder journal survive later Stop/timeout/model/save failure and deleted chats. Intent failure prevents write; receipt failure is honest pending. Completed conversation metadata/export remains separate. Explicit local reviewed revert added in brick 3.6.

creation.arguments: {path:string,content:string}; both required, no extra fields; direct relative path under an existing directory. Complete UTF-8 text including empty files, within the 4096-byte JSON argument cap and 16384-byte file/diff caps. Secret/VCS/device/alias paths excluded; no mkdir.
creation.preview: Complete literal addition, /dev/null before header and missing-newline markers; call/target/diff-bound Create once/Deny. Preparation never writes.
creation.publication: Exclusive staged file, flush, durable intent, cancellation/direct-parent/absence checks, then no-overwrite hard-link publication. Existing entry always refused; unsupported filesystems fail with no rename fallback. Cleanup owned staging name only.
creation.result: status created; JSON {applied:true,created:true,bytesBefore:0,bytesAfter,changeId,journalStatus:applied|pending}; unjournaled alternate registration omits changeId/journalStatus. Applied effects remain after later chat failure or deletion.

workingSessions.temporary: distinct app-data/workspaces/<session id> directory created on first send; persisted across restart, not auto-erased
workingSessions.binding: immutable per conversation; saved root authoritative; missing folder never falls back
workingSessions.privacy: absolute roots are local host/UI state, excluded from automatic provider context and exports
workingSessions.delete: association cascades, working files and recent projects preserved
workingSessions.newChat: sidebar New chat starts temporary; project + creates project chat; menu offers explicit side mode

changeJournal.scope: saved canonical working folder, retained independently of chat deletion; 20 summary rows per page and one detail
changeJournal.snapshots: private unencrypted before/after UTF-8 snapshots, each <=16384 bytes; not automatically sent to provider or included in conversation exports; old edits not backfilled. Explicit beforeExists/afterExists distinguishes absent from existing empty files; schema-7 edits migrate true/true unchanged.
changeJournal.publication: FULL-synchronous pending intent before replacement; intent failure prevents write; receipt failure preserves applied result with journalStatus pending; no automatic reconciliation or rollback. Creation uses hard-link publication without overwriting. Local reversal of a creation removes only matching saved bytes after a separate approval; receipt failure reports actual removal with pending status.
changeJournal.revert: local-only separate preview/approval with unpredictable one-use session/root/change-bound token, 300-second expiry; changed bytes/ordinary permissions/direct path refused; new intent and atomic original/revert receipts; no reverse-of-reverse. Preview operation is restore or remove. Original creations use Remove once; changed/missing files refused, no arbitrary model deletion or reverse-of-removal. Removal checks are optimistic, not atomic cross-process CAS.
changeJournal.limits: one pending plan, bounded snapshots/page/UI; growing disk retention; no idle work or new worker
changeJournal.concurrency: optimistic filesystem checks, not cross-process compare-and-swap; ordinary permissions only, no universal ACL/xattr guarantees

apiKey.description: Required argument, may be empty; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, no CR/LF; replaces the in-memory credential.

x-error-result.description: Invocation rejection with a user-facing error; no stable error codes in v1.

baseUrl.description: At most 2048 UTF-8 bytes; HTTPS or HTTP loopback, no userinfo/query/fragment.

model.description: Nonblank, at most 200 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters.

DeltaEvent.description: First event has an empty delta acknowledging native run reservation; subsequent events contain ordered plain text.

retryable.description: Manual retry action only; does not initiate a new request.

guidance.description: Fixed local text; never a raw provider body.

target.description: Resolved relative path, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; never absolute root

query.description: Search only; nonblank case-sensitive literal single-line text, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; no controls/regex. Omitted for legacy/read/listing records.

diff.description: Optional replacement/creation literal unified diff; at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; required for write approval, old records omit it.

target.description: Relative target or fixed blocked-path label; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes

content.description: At most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; literal file content or fixed local refusal/error

query.description: Search only; nonblank case-sensitive literal single-line text, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; no controls/regex. Omitted for legacy/read/listing records.

diff.description: Optional replacement/creation literal unified diff; at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; required for write approval, old records omit it.

steps.description: Optional public commentary before tool calls; omitted when empty/legacy, final answer excluded.

root.description: Canonical absolute private local path; null only for side mode

text.description: Public intermediate assistant text; hidden reasoning omitted; 131072 UTF-8 bytes across all model text including final answer.

beforeExists.description: Explicit existence, independent of zero byte count. Schema-7 replacements migrate true.

afterExists.description: Explicit existence, independent of zero byte count. Schema-7 replacements migrate true.

x-provider-chat.response: text/event-stream; usage may arrive in an empty-choices chunk before [DONE]; last valid snapshot replaces, never sums prior snapshots
x-provider-chat.compatibility: Retry once without stream_options only after HTTP 400/422 with an <=8192-byte JSON error explicitly naming stream_options/include_usage as unsupported/unknown/unrecognized/unexpected/not permitted. Never retry denial, generic validation, transport or stream failures. Error bodies are not surfaced.

x-provider-tools.messages: Initial system/history/user, then assistant tool_calls:[{id,type:function,function:{name,arguments}}], followed by tool messages {role:tool,content,tool_call_id:id}; local approval/policy runs before tool content is shared
x-provider-tools.response: application/json; bounded choices[0].message with content/tool_calls, usage and finish_reason stop|tool_calls; malformed/incomplete/output-limited responses fail
x-provider-tools.compatibility: No tool fallback or automatic failure retry. Ordinary chat stays SSE.
